taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-23, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 994.7 | 15.91 | 15.91
2 | 1719.5 | 4.88 | 20.79
3 | 7929.4 | 21.88 | 42.67
4 | 8125.6 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-23, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

Station T-23 in survey area T exhibits a four-layer sequence characterized by a continuous increase in resistivity with depth. The profile starts with a layer of 994.7 ohm-m extending to 15.91 m, followed by a 4.88 m thick layer of 1719.5 ohm-m. A third layer with a resistivity of 7929.4 ohm-m is encountered down to a depth of 42.67 m, transitioning into a fourth layer of 8125.6 ohm-m. Following the vertical electrical sounding (VES) notation rules, the sequence of increasing resistivities (r1 < r2 < r3 and r2 < r3 < r4) results in an AA-type curve. This calculation is consistent with the classification currently on file.

{"curve_type_stated": "AA", "label_issue_flagged": false}
